name: doable-code-context
description: Connect private code to Doable through MCP: resolve grounded context requests, serve Doable code agent requests from a machine, and drive Doable chats.

interface.shortDescription: Answer Doable from private code and drive its chat
interface.longDescription: Connect the current private workspace through the configured Doable MCP connection and answer frozen context requests with grounded findings; on a machine that holds the product's repositories, serve the requests a Doable chat sends (code questions, test data preparation, backend checks and bug reports); or drive a Doable chat that writes and runs tests. Context answers keep exact source locations local; code agent results may hold file paths, line numbers and short code excerpts, never secrets.
defaultPrompt: Resolve Doable context request DQ-7F3K for organization HireEZ (hireez).
Serve Doable code agent requests on this machine.
Ask Doable's chat to test the feature I just implemented.
